audience: payroll and HR teams who run pay in Employment Hero Payroll

useCases.title: Review a pay run and its warnings
useCases.text: The AI lists pay runs, reads hours, gross and net wages of one, and lists its warnings, for example an employee paid below the award rate or with negative net pay.

useCases.title: Check pay per employee in a pay run
useCases.text: The AI reads per-employee totals (gross, net, tax, super) or the pay slip data of a pay run with earnings, deductions and leave taken.

useCases.title: Run a gross-to-net report
useCases.text: The AI reads earnings by pay category, tax, deductions, super and net pay per employee for a date range or one finalised pay run.

useCases.title: Check leave balances of staff
useCases.text: The AI reads the leave balances of one employee, or a report for all employees as at a date (up to 200 rows), per leave category.

useCases.title: Review timesheets by employee or date
useCases.text: The AI lists timesheet lines with employee, start and end time, units, work type, location and status, filtered by employee or date.

useCases.title: Approve or decline leave requests
useCases.text: The AI lists pending leave requests, reads one, and approves it or declines it with a reason the employee sees.
